title: Exact logo replacement + browser Notifications API settings and in-app notifications

requirements.summary: Replace all in-app logo placements to use only the uploaded logo raster asset exactly as provided.
acceptanceCriteria: InitialLoadSplash displays the uploaded logo image exactly (no color/shape changes)
Settings → About displays the uploaded logo image exactly (no color/shape changes)
No other logo asset is shown anywhere in the UI (only the uploaded logo)

file_operations.description: Add the required generated square logo asset as an exact raster conversion of the uploaded image.png at frontend/public/assets/generated/bunkpro-logo.dim_1024x1024.png.
Create a small branding helper exporting the single allowed logo asset path and related accessible alt text so all logo placements reference the same source of truth.
Update the splash screen to import and use the shared branding logo path (from frontend/src/lib/branding.ts) so the only displayed logo is the uploaded logo asset exactly as provided.
Update Settings → About to import and use the shared branding logo path (from frontend/src/lib/branding.ts) and ensure no other logo assets are referenced anywhere in this card.

requirements.summary: Set the browser tab favicon to the generated favicon derived from the uploaded logo.
acceptanceCriteria: The favicon shown in the browser tab uses the uploaded logo image
The favicon asset is served from frontend static assets and referenced by frontend/index.html

file_operations.description: Add the required generated favicon asset as an exact favicon conversion of the uploaded image.png at frontend/public/assets/generated/bunkpro-favicon.dim_32x32.png.
Verify and (if needed) update the favicon <link> tag to reference frontend/public/assets/generated/bunkpro-favicon.dim_32x32.png so the tab icon matches the uploaded logo exactly.

requirements.summary: Add browser Notifications API support with permission prompting, an enable/disable toggle, and a Settings test notification action.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings includes a Notifications section with: (1) enable/disable toggle and (2) “Send test notification” button
If permission is not granted, the UI clearly indicates that permission is required and provides an action to request permission
When notifications are disabled in Settings, the app does not send notifications even if permission is granted
Notifications work in supported desktop browsers (same implementation powers both 'web' and 'desktop' notifications)

file_operations.description: Implement a small wrapper around the browser Notifications API (support detection, current permission state, permission request, and sending notifications) to centralize logic and ensure consistent permission/setting checks.

Create a Settings Notifications section UI. Use the shadcn-ui components (Card, Button, Switch, Label) to provide an enable/disable toggle, a permission request action when needed, and a “Send test notification” button. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new NotificationsCard into Settings and connect it to global state (read current preference, dispatch updates). Use shadcn-ui layout patterns already present on the page. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Extend AppSettings and DEFAULT_SETTINGS to include notification preference(s) (e.g., enableNotifications) with safe defaults, without altering existing attendance calculation logic or other data model behavior.

requirements.summary: Trigger in-app/on-device notifications (while the app is running) after successful class marking, respecting user setting and permission state.
acceptanceCriteria: After a user marks a class (attended/missed/cancelled) successfully, the app can show a notification summarizing the action when notifications are enabled and permission is granted
No notification is shown if notifications are disabled or permission is not granted
The notification content is in English and does not contain Caffeine branding

file_operations.description: Add helper(s) to build English notification title/body strings summarizing attendance marking actions (attended/missed/cancelled) with no Caffeine branding.

After successfully saving marked classes (after dispatching ADD_EVENTS), call the notifications wrapper to show a local notification summary only when notifications are enabled in settings and browser permission is granted.

requirements.summary: Persist notification preferences through existing IndexedDB persistence and export/import backup flow without breaking older backups.
acceptanceCriteria: Importing an older backup (without notification fields) still works and defaults notification preference(s) safely

file_operations.description: Ensure backup migration continues to merge settings with updated DEFAULT_SETTINGS so older backups without notification fields import safely and notification preference(s) default correctly.
Confirm loaded state validation and fallbacks remain compatible after adding notification preference(s) to settings, preserving existing stored data behavior.
Ensure DEFAULT_SETTINGS contains the notification preference default so both IndexedDB load and backup migration reliably populate it when missing.

requirements.summary: Add clear English explanatory copy in Settings describing notification behavior and limitations for this web app.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings shows English explanatory text describing permission requirements and that notifications are only triggered while the app is running (no push delivery guarantee)

file_operations.description: Add clear English user-facing copy explaining: notifications require browser permission; notifications are triggered only while the app is running; and there is no guaranteed delivery when the app/browser is closed. Use shadcn-ui typography/layout conventions. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
